# Vendored browser runtime

`chart.umd.js` is the unmodified UMD distribution from `chart.js@4.4.7`.
It is served locally so authenticated dashboards do not depend on a public CDN.
The upstream MIT license is preserved in `chart.js-LICENSE.md`.

`lucide.min.js` is the unmodified UMD distribution from `lucide@0.469.0`.
It is served locally so public pages render icons without a CDN (offline-first).
The upstream ISC license is preserved in `lucide-LICENSE.md` (and in the file header).

`fabric.min.js` is the unmodified UMD distribution of Fabric.js (cdnjs `fabric.js/5.3.0`).
It is served locally so the Studio editor loads without a CDN (offline-first).
The upstream MIT license is preserved in `fabric-LICENSE.md`.
